originalScope.name: 02_MASTER_SCOPE.md
originalScope.source: Original user-provided canonical Family Lab master scope; not copied to public GitHub

evidenceLimits: Historic classifications and source/test path existence are NOT proof that every bullet was audited, runtime-executed or clinically accepted. F0 is a traceable triage baseline only.
